articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Crypto PAC notches primary wins, but loses $2M Florida race
articles.description: A Fairshake spokesperson said that the PAC was “just getting started“ on its expenditures as part of efforts to fill US Congress with lawmakers friendly to the crypto industry.

articles.title: FalconX, Ethena bring USDe backing assets into $1B institutional credit facility
articles.description: The $1 billion facility will deploy assets backing USDe into overcollateralized institutional loans, expanding Ethena’s sources of returns beyond crypto basis strategies.

articles.title: OCC head promises final GENIUS rules by November
articles.description: The US banking regulator released a 376‑page proposal in February, calling for public comment on rules to implement the stablecoin bill ahead of its January 2027 effective date.

articles.title: StanChart, HSBC execute first live transaction on Swift blockchain ledger
articles.description: The transaction connected the banks’ separate tokenized deposit systems through Swift’s ledger, marking a step toward interoperable, 24/7 cross-border payments.

articles.title: Standard Chartered analyst eyes $100K BTC as US Treasury doubles long-end buybacks
articles.description: Bitcoin’s rebound toward $69,000 is gaining momentum as Geoff Kendrick points to improving liquidity conditions and a potential cycle bottom.

articles.title: US commodities regulator imposes 5-year trading ban on ex-Alameda, FTX execs
articles.description: The consent orders ended the CFTC’s case against two former crypto executives after FTX and Alameda agreed to $12.7 billion in disgorgement and restitution payments in August 2024.

articles.title: Bitcoin price hits 11-week high as US Treasury doubles debt buyback size
articles.description: Bitcoin joined US stocks in a broad rally after the US Treasury announced that it was at least doubling the amount of its debt buyback operations from September.

articles.title: Injective receives SEC transfer agent registration for institutional services arm
articles.description: Injective’s affiliated entity can now maintain securities ownership records, adding regulated market infrastructure to its growing push into tokenized assets.

articles.title: 200,000 fake AI ‘victims’ deployed to scam bait online fraudsters
articles.description: Apate’s 200,000 fake AI ‘victims’ are so good at scam baiting, the company has a monthly KPI for how many F-bombs scammers drop at the infuriating bots.

articles.title: SEC regulatory proposal marks ‘important’ step forward from ‘inapt’ crypto rules: Commissioner Peirce
articles.description: “Crypto mom” Hester Peirce praised the SEC’s proposed crypto regime, published days after the Senate failed to pass the CLARITY Act, the US’ first comprehensive industry framework.

articles.title: Centrifuge adds Symbiotic liquidity network across $1.6B in Janus Henderson, NYLIM funds
articles.description: Symbiotic’s Liquid Lane gives eligible holders immediate USDC liquidity across three Centrifuge funds managed by Janus Henderson and NYLIM.

articles.title: Sweden’s H100 reports $26M H1 loss driven by falling Bitcoin value
articles.description: Sweden’s H100 reported a $26 million loss for the first half of the year, as it completed its acquisitions to become Europe’s second-largest Bitcoin treasury by holdings.

articles.title: Ripple raises $275M for US prime brokerage to meet institutional demand
articles.description: Ripple said the $275 million raised will support its expansion into traditional financial services such as prime brokerage and multi-asset clearing, citing strong demand from institutions.

articles.title: Bitcoin has ‘largely purged’ froth that preceded 50% drop from $126K: BlackRock
articles.description: Bitcoin maintained its appeal as a diversification investment despite dropping more than 50% from all-time high, a BlackRock report stated.

articles.title: Nexo launches regulated crypto-backed credit in Australia
articles.description: Nexo introduced regulated, cryptocurrency-backed credit lines that allow users to access liquidity in Australian dollars or stablecoins by borrowing against their digital assets.

articles.title: Arthur Hayes takes CEO role at Flop Labs ahead of Q4 airdrop
articles.description: Hayes revealed his new role as Flop Labs CEO and teased a “massive airdrop” from the AI inference protocol in the fourth quarter of 2026.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs add $189M as August net inflows approach $1B
articles.description: US spot Bitcoin ETFs took in $189 million on Tuesday, lifting August net inflows to $951 million, while Ether ETFs added $71.5 million.

articles.title: MAYAChain halts network after estimated $1.7M exploit
articles.description: A preliminary analysis says six chained bugs let a 23-message transaction drain 48.87 million CACAO, sending the token down nearly 89%.

articles.title: US accounting board FASB proposes conditions for stablecoins as cash equivalents
articles.description: The FASB said secondary-market liquidity alone would not be enough, with holders needing direct issuer redemption rights and one-to-one liquid reserves.

articles.title: SEC proposes new crypto rules in absence of CLARITY Act
articles.description: The proposed rules from the US securities regulator would provide companies with a safe harbor from tokens being treated as “investment contracts” and certain exemptions for token issuance.

articles.title: FalconX, Interstice Connect Canton to Ethereum, Solana and Robinhood Chain
articles.description: The non-custodial cross-chain swap engine connects Canton’s institutional tokenized-asset markets with liquidity and trading activity across major public blockchains.

articles.title: Ripple- and Coinbase-funded PAC spends $2M in Florida race with little mention of crypto
articles.description: A Florida representative not running for reelection who voted against the GENIUS and CLARITY Acts has endorsed a Democratic candidate, possibly leading to PAC-funded negative ads.

articles.title: Cypherpunk launches Zcash mining fleet controlling 18% of network hashrate
articles.description: The $33.3 million Winklevoss Capital deal expands Cypherpunk’s ZEC strategy as it targets 5% ownership of the cryptocurrency’s circulating supply.

articles.title: Kraken’s Krak debuts US debit card as Payward broadens financial services push
articles.description: The multi-asset card lets US customers spend crypto and fiat and earn cashback as Kraken’s parent company expands across financial services.

articles.title: Federal prosecutors blast ex-Celsius CEO’s motion to vacate as ‘without merit’
articles.description: Currently serving a 12-year sentence in federal prison, Alex Mashinsky continues to explore legal avenues to vacate his conviction related to activities at Celsius.

articles.title: Metaplanet expands Bitcoin treasury strategy to US with 2,100-BTC Nasdaq play
articles.description: The proposed deal with Nasdaq-listed Super League Enterprise would give the Tokyo-based company a foothold in US capital markets while using existing Bitcoin rather than additional purchases.

articles.title: Neuberger teams with Securitize on multi-chain tokenized fixed-income fund launch
articles.description: The $613 billion asset manager will subadvise a high-yield fund tokenized across Ethereum, Solana, Avalanche and Sui.

articles.title: Bitcoin tags $65K as S&P 500 rebounds from 2-week lows on US-Iran rhetoric
articles.description: Bitcoin returned to $65,000 for the first time in a week as fresh BTC price volatility accompanied US claims that the Strait of Hormuz was “open and operating.”

articles.title: Toyota Finance opens tokenized bonds to retail investors via mobile payment app
articles.description: Retail investors can apply to buy the 1 billion yen bond without a securities account and receive perks through Toyota’s payment app.
